messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the UR10e manual, with whom does the responsibility rest for disposing of the robot in accordance with the applicable national laws, regulations and standards?

response.text: Secondo il manuale dell'UR10e, a chi spetta la responsabilità di smaltire il robot in conformità alle leggi, ai regolamenti e alle norme nazionali applicabili?
